pages.text: The Grottoceratops is a large herbivorous dinosaur that lives in the Primordial Caves. Using their favorite curled ferns, a dark magician can easily control and summon these ceratopsians.

Wearing Wild Robe restores your dinosaurs' health. Feeding them Curled Ferns heals your Grottoceratops. Tree Stars can be used to breed your Grottoceratops; a breeding pair will lay an egg, and the hatchling will still recognize you as its master.
